a11y.metaDescription: T° Studio's accessibility statement: the accessibility level, the adjustments made and how to contact us about accessibility.
a11y.title: Accessibility statement
a11y.intro: At T° Studio we want everyone to be able to use this website comfortably, including people with disabilities. The site was built and tested according to Israel's Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities (Service Accessibility Adjustments) Regulations, 2013.
a11y.level: The site meets Israeli Standard IS 5568, which is based on WCAG 2.0 level AA. Beyond that, it was built to WCAG 2.2 level AA.
done: Full keyboard navigation, with a clear focus indicator and a "Skip to content" link at the top of every page.
Semantic structure: headings in hierarchical order, page landmarks (header, navigation, main content, footer) and lists.
Screen reader support: text alternatives for images, language marked on text in other languages, and decorative elements hidden from screen readers.
Color contrast that meets AA requirements for all text and interface components.
Responsive layout that supports zoom up to 400% and larger text without losing content or scrolling sideways.
The system "reduce motion" setting is respected: animation and video play only when the visitor hasn't asked to reduce motion, and nothing on the site flashes.
Contact form: a label on every field, required fields marked, clear error messages next to the field, and a success message announced to screen readers.
Links that open in a new tab say so.
a11y.tested: The site was tested with automated tools (axe-core and Lighthouse), keyboard navigation, and mobile and desktop layouts, in Hebrew (right to left) and English, in Chrome.
a11y.limits: We are not aware of any inaccessible parts of the site. If you run into a problem, please tell us so we can fix it.
a11y.noWidget: The site does not use an accessibility plugin ("accessibility button"). The adjustments were made directly in the site's code, and you can use the accessibility tools built into your browser and operating system (zoom, screen reader, high contrast).
a11y.contactIntro: Ran into an accessibility problem or have a suggestion? We'd like to hear from you and will get back to you soon.
a11y.contactForm: or use the contact form on the site
a11y.contactTip: To help us handle your request, please mention the page where you ran into the problem, what you were trying to do, and which browser and assistive technology you used.
